speech: I found three things. Two lights answer to Living Room Light. The hall motion sensor battery is at 6%. And the kitchen plug dropped off Wi-Fi 9 times today.

findings.title: Two lights answer to Living Room Light
findings.detail: A Hue group and a Zigbee bulb are both called Living Room Light, so a command can reach the wrong one.

findings.title: Hall motion sensor battery at 6%
findings.detail: At 6% it may stop reporting motion soon.

findings.title: Kitchen plug dropped off Wi-Fi 9 times today
findings.detail: Its Wi-Fi signal is weak, at -82 dBm. Moving the plug or the router closer usually helps.
